seq_interior.note: seq_interior x y s is the set of the vertices of the raw sequence s other than the given endpoints x and y (seq_vertices s :\: [set x; y]), with no walk, uniqueness or nonemptiness premise: [::] has none, [:: v] keeps v unless v is an endpoint, repeated vertices count once, equal endpoints remove one value, absent endpoints remove nothing, the head-plus-tail sequence x :: s gives the same set as s, and endpoints are removed as values (an endpoint value repeated inside s is not internal); on a packaged Path it is coq-graph-theory's interior.

seq_inner.note: seq_inner s removes the first and the last entry of a nonempty s as values and is set0 on [::] and on singletons, i.e. seq_interior of the sequence's own endpoints; on a packaged Path it is coq-graph-theory's interior.
